exactExistingMatches.basis: Coalesced chord roots and exact quarter-beat boundaries under one constant transposition

records.matching: nested named definitions; constant transposition; explicit equivalence families; exact duration ratios or wildcard durations; minimum dictionary cost; no Java inexact-duration fallback
records.unknowns: Unsupported cells remain clipped/silent with actual source symbol/timing retained. Explicit NC is separately marked noHarmony and remains silent; it is not an unsupported chord quality.
records.discovery: Exact relative-root, compound-quality, explicit-bass and relative-duration patterns in unexplained spans. At least three distinct imported compositions; generic ii-V-I and POT excluded; known meaningful bricks take priority. Dictionary additions are existing sourced rules absent from the original roadmap labels, not newly invented music-theory names.
